body.state_reason: The runner stopped with an error and did not start again after three tries. The model gateway is not reachable from the machine container, so every model call fails before it begins. Check that the gateway key is set in the edge service, that the edge service is running, and that the machine container can reach it on its network; then wake the agent again. If the same message comes back, ask a human to look at the edge service log.
